evidence.observation: Growth began ~10 °C above setpoint and drifted down to 750 °C over ~200 s while heater power rose 38%→44%, suggesting a slow control/thermal transient rather than steady state
Tube pressure stepped abruptly from ~3.06 to ~3.31 Torr with Ar flow unchanged at 100 sccm
Pressure stepped back to ~3.05 Torr, again with no change in Ar or temperature — a transient partial exhaust restriction during ~240 s of growth
Cooldown proceeds normally: heater off, Ar 200 sccm, P ~4.06 Torr, smooth ~0.4 °C/s decay
O2 stays 3–6 ppm throughout, no leak signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (Raman/AFM/optical) of the film, plus exhaust line/valve inspection or a pressure-vs-flow check to confirm the transient restriction at t≈3005–3245 s
